tests.scenario: Import new static PNG through supported self-service path
tests.expected_result: Preview and enable without source changes; capability clearly static

tests.scenario: Import arbitrary state names through UI mapping
tests.expected_result: Map declared states, playback drives talk, stop returns neutral

tests.scenario: Import missing optional blink/talk state
tests.expected_result: Use documented neutral fallback; do not block basic chat or pretend missing animation

tests.scenario: Load supported pinned Live2D runtime package
tests.expected_result: Resolve local dependencies and actually render; shape validation alone insufficient

tests.scenario: Use second independent model with custom parameter IDs and numeric ranges
tests.expected_result: Discover/map parameters within application; no filename/character-name hardcoding

tests.scenario: Introduce held-out valid package after implementation freeze
tests.expected_result: Supported path works or failure recorded in compatibility matrix

tests.scenario: Malformed JSON, duplicate keys, false extension and invalid model entrypoint
tests.expected_result: Reject deterministically without replacing current character

tests.scenario: Missing texture/moc/motion, corrupt decodable content or circular dependency
tests.expected_result: Distinguish blocking missing dependency from optional capability fallback

tests.scenario: Unsupported model/runtime/schema/renderer version
tests.expected_result: Reject or isolate supported downgrade only when explicitly verified; no false support claim

tests.scenario: Nonfinite/reversed parameter range, unsupported or absent mouth mapping
tests.expected_result: Validate numeric bounds; neutral fallback when allowed; do not drive unrelated controls

tests.scenario: Relative traversal, absolute/drive/UNC paths, Unicode/case collisions and duplicate archive entries
tests.expected_result: No write/read outside package root and no conflicting overwrite

tests.scenario: Symlink/hardlink escape, remote URI or data reference requiring network
tests.expected_result: Reject external resolution and unsafe links; no network request

tests.scenario: Executable script/plugin, privilege claim or credentials in package manifest
tests.expected_result: Do not execute, elevate or install capability; explain unsupported data

tests.scenario: Archive expansion, excessive entries/depth/compression ratio around chosen limits
tests.expected_result: Abort before resource budget violation; old package remains active; later normal import works

tests.scenario: Small compressed image with huge dimensions and multiple decoded textures
tests.expected_result: Bound decoded pixels/texture resources, not only upload size; abort and release staging

tests.scenario: Complex mesh/physics and concurrent current-plus-preview loading
tests.expected_result: Enforce preview/load budget without killing active model; expose observed compatibility

tests.scenario: Cancel while copying, extracting, loading and previewing
tests.expected_result: No partial activation; bounded cleanup; current revision unchanged

tests.scenario: Disk full, process interruption or validation/load error during update
tests.expected_result: Old valid revision remains usable; next launch resolves transaction deterministically

tests.scenario: Import identical package again and update existing revision
tests.expected_result: Stable content identity or explicit new revision; no silent destructive overwrite

tests.scenario: Change appearance within same character profile
tests.expected_result: Keep permitted identity/conversation; stop old revision callbacks; no accidental new personality

tests.scenario: Switch between independent character profiles with distinct canary facts
tests.expected_result: No unauthorized cross-profile prompt/history/memory/task content

tests.scenario: Switch/delete during TTS download, playback, motion or expression callback
tests.expected_result: Old generation or asset revision cannot resume sound/motion; one audio owner

tests.scenario: Delete current/non-current package with separate preserve/delete relationship-data choice
tests.expected_result: Operate only within confirmed scope; deactivate removed revision; original project files untouched

tests.scenario: Restore old backup after deletion/forgetting or package revision replacement
tests.expected_result: Do not revive forgotten facts/removed output; missing assets remain explicit

tests.scenario: Small window, mixed DPI, alpha edges, click-through and focus changes
tests.expected_result: Visible character and usable input/stop; no asset-specific focus or hit-test traps

tests.scenario: Repeat switch/preview/delete/hide/restore and compare full process tree
tests.expected_result: No retained old audio/texture/timer growth; report stable-window resource trends

tests.scenario: Source/license metadata present, missing, conflicting or restrictive
tests.expected_result: Display declared rights separately from verification; no automatic upload/public sharing

tests.scenario: Malicious persona/config tries to grant tools or access public/private channel data
tests.expected_result: Character content never grants OS/tools/channel authorization
